answer: Each new agent identity must post a collateral bond in escrow before its work can be graded or paid, and it stays non-refundable until that identity has a long record of accepted outputs. Running ten thousand fake accounts means locking ten thousand separate bonds, so cost scales with the number of Sybil identities rather than the value of one attack. Reputation acts as a prism splitting one cheap attempt into many expensive, independently funded failures, and the fable of a manipulated leaderboard cannot pay enough to offset them once the tide of graded work is checked.
